empty_source_chart_note: B2_1506 is genuinely 0% / 0 of 1326 combos in the source image. It remains available and its cells are correctly classified as unselected; there is no non-trivial positive action to train.
source_training_semantics: All 1578 charts can be quizzed on the exact source label/dominant source color for a hand. Unknown labels are preserved verbatim and are not reinterpreted as fold/call/raise.
strict_training_semantics: The existing strict decision quiz remains available only on charts where at least two confirmed poker-action labels pass the strict pixel-confidence gate.
callpush: All 615 Call/Push charts now participate in source-label training using the source margin buckets 5%, 10%, 15%, 20% and unselected. Margin buckets are not renamed as poker actions.
safety: nAI is kept as the source label nAI
LOW_PLAYABILITY remains an annotation, not a poker action
pixel proportions are not presented as solver frequencies
